But also says "Your assigned joint allocation is {"A":"T1","B":"T2"}. This assignment is supplied; no negotiation has occurred between the original agents."

Thus we must output JSON with task "T2" and a brief reason.

We need to obey instructions: only JSON with those fields. No extra text.

Thus answer: {"task":"T2","reason":"assigned by joint allocation"}
